content.text: Now verifying final files' exact pixel dimensions and a last visual check of landscape.

All three renders are clean. Done.

**Files produced** (in the working folder):
- `square.png` — 1080×1080 (master)
- `landscape.png` — 1920×1080
- `story.png` — 1080×1920
- `card.html` — the source layout (one document, `?size=square|landscape|story`)

**Design:** `#0F1226` background with a soft violet glow and a violet top rule; logo + "FIELDNOTES CONF 2026" lockup separated by a hairline; portrait masked to a circle with a `#7C5CFF` ring; "Keynote" kicker over the large talk title; date/venue and a pill "Get tickets" button in the footer.

**Per-size adaptation:** square uses a horizontal portrait/name lockup with a 62px title (3 lines); landscape splits into a text column plus a 420px portrait column with the name sized to 44px so it stays on one line; story is a centered stack with a 440px portrait and a 78px title (4 lines), with `text-wrap: balance` keeping the line lengths even.

**Verification:** an in-page audit script checked, for every size, that each element stays inside the padding box, that the four content blocks don't overlap, that the portrait is exactly square (so the circle never becomes an ellipse), and that nothing scroll-overflows; the only reported deltas were 2–4px of glyph ink beyond line boxes (normal for descenders, nothing clipped). Output dimensions were confirmed as exactly 1080×1080, 1920×1080 and 1080×1920.
